test_title: PYST 33: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8a9c16e1ecdf6d9fa7e833f57d1afba7e11a1e505d55a5694035af1357dae68.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Number of sides of figure is decreasing by 1.

Number of dots are decreasing by 1.

**Number of sides - 1 = Number of dots.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bb27d980bfbbaafa22df969044187237844450e7abd3fe913f0e620a21537ba.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
